query: For high-entropy alloys, what single intervention could improve dynamic strength–ductility performance? Formulate one hypothesis that identifies the intervention, explains its mechanism, predicts the improvement relative to an untreated baseline, defines the boundary conditions under which it should hold, cites supporting prior evidence, and proposes a decisive experiment that could falsify it.

generation.hypothesis: Intervention of grain refinement through severe plastic deformation can improve dynamic strength-ductility performance in high-entropy alloys
generation.intervention: grain refinement through severe plastic deformation
generation.mechanism: enhanced dislocation mobility and grain boundary strengthening
generation.boundary: high-entropy alloys with grain size > 10 um
generation.uncertainty: effect of grain refinement on dynamic strength-ductility performance may vary depending on alloy composition and processing history
generation.falsification_experiment: compare dynamic strength-ductility performance of high-entropy alloys with and without grain refinement through severe plastic deformation
